title: The Pack of good old Confusion
description: A clean texture pack that makes your brain more confused than that one math test in '91
body:
This is the first official release of the Texture pack made for confusion while playing.

This texture pack changes the textures of:

The sun and the moon
The water fog
Water/Lava
Entities
Blocks


We are planning on adding more custom textures soon.

!THIS IS MY FIRST EVER PACK!


Anyways. This texture pack and idea is fully made by Jitscraft
You are allowed to use this pack for video's or tiktok slideshows or republishing it with updates.


Thank you all for checking this pack out and goobye!
